description: stablecoin-1 tightens exactly one control of aegs-2 and relaxes none.
note: The list of tightened controls is pinned at exactly one, and that is the restraint being tested rather than a detail of the manifest. A vertical profile is where scope creep is cheapest -- ConformanceDeclaration, ComplianceAssessment and IncidentRecord could each be argued into an obliged entity's profile, and each would raise a bar nobody in the vertical could clear for reasons unrelated to the vertical. One new requirement is a bar; four are a wishlist. If this vector ever needs updating, the question to ask first is whether the new requirement is one the named deployment class already meets.
